subject: Nexovate POC: security acceptance criteria & MAP timeline
messages:
From: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>
To: Emily Chen <emily.chen@nexovate.com>, Daniel Park <daniel.park@nexovate.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-06-18T10:12:00-07:00
Subject: Nexovate POC: security acceptance criteria & MAP timeline

Hi Emily / Daniel —

Thanks again for the time yesterday. Per our conversation, attached is a draft Mutual Action Plan (MAP) that captures the evaluation milestones and the security/compliance gates your legal and infosec teams asked us to confirm. Key items in this MAP:

- SOC 2: we can provide the latest SOC 2 Type II report and a short evidence bundle (see SOC2_summary.pdf).
- SIG/CAIQ: our preliminary CAIQ answers are attached (SIG-CAIQ_answers.xlsx); Aditya will own any follow-ups.
- DPA & data residency: attached is a company-standard DPA with our suggested redlines (DPA-redline.docx). Please share any redline from your side.
- Data retention & deletion: summary included in the MAP (Nexovate_MAP_v1.xlsx) — default retention for POC logs is 90 days; we can extend to a customer-configured retention policy for production.

Proposed timeline (high-level):
- June 22: POC kickoff (technical onboarding)
- June 22–July 6: 2-week evaluation window (SIG/CAIQ questions and SOC evidence review)
- By July 8: Security signoff target (or list of blockers)
- By July 12: Procurement & DPA executed (target close)

Can you confirm the evaluation window and whether your legal team can return a DPA redline by June 25? If we get that, our legal and Aditya's team will prioritize rapid turnaround.

Attachments: Nexovate_MAP_v1.xlsx, SOC2_summary.pdf, SIG-CAIQ_answers.xlsx, DPA-redline.docx

Best,
Tessa Morgan
Enterprise Account Executive
Redwood Inference
Mobile: +1 (415) 555-0128
From: Emily Chen <emily.chen@nexovate.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>
Cc: Daniel Park <daniel.park@nexovate.com>
Date: 2026-06-18T11:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Nexovate POC: security acceptance criteria & MAP timeline

Tessa —

Thanks, this is helpful. Quick clarifying questions before we kick off:
1) On SOC 2: is the Type II report within the last 12 months and do you have an SOC2 auditor contact or ATO summary? We can expedite review if we have both.
2) On data retention: for the POC will any customer data be replicated outside US regions? We need confirmation that customer data will remain in us-east-1 for this trial.
3) On the CAIQ: will your team accept an iterative Q&A cadence (we'll log questions in a shared sheet) or do you prefer a single pass?

Looping in our procurement lead (Daniel) — he will coordinate DPA timing with our legal team.

We should be able to return a DPA redline by June 25 if nothing unexpected comes up, but need the SOC timing confirmed.

—Emily Chen
Head of Product, Nexovate
emily.chen@nexovate.com
From: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
To: Emily Chen <emily.chen@nexovate.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-06-19T09:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Nexovate POC: security acceptance criteria & MAP timeline

Emily — quick technical responses inline below: 

1) SOC 2: our latest Type II report is dated 2026-02 and covers the control period through 2025-12. The SOC2_summary.pdf includes the auditor contact (Summit Audit Group) and a short ATO-style summary for the controls most relevant to inference workloads (access controls, change management, encryption at rest/in transit).

2) Data residency: for the POC we will deploy to your requested region (us-east-1) and no customer model/data will be replicated outside of that region. Logs required for platform health (anonymized telemetry) are retained in us regions; full customer payloads live only in the provisioned region.

3) CAIQ cadence: iterative Q&A is fine — please add questions to the shared CAIQ tab in the Drive link and we'll reply within 48 business hours for POC items. For high-priority blockers we can set up an emergency sync.

Attachments referenced above include the SOC2_summary.pdf and SIG-CAIQ_answers.xlsx. I've also created a read-only drive folder: https://drive.google.com/open?id=1Nexovate-MAP (shared with your emails).

Let me know if you want a short tech walk-through during kickoff June 22 — I can block 30 minutes.

Thanks,
Aditya Rao
Sales Engineer, Redwood Inference
aditya.rao@redwood.com
From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
To: Daniel Park <daniel.park@nexovate.com>, Emily Chen <emily.chen@nexovate.com>
Cc: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-06-19T15:20:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Nexovate POC: security acceptance criteria & MAP timeline

Hi Emily / Daniel —

Thanks for the note. A couple of legal items to set expectations:
- DPA: we've attached our suggested redlines (DPA-redline.docx) that are standard for POC usage. If you return a redline by June 25, our legal team can typically turn around comments within 3 business days.
- Insurance & indemnity: our standard limits are noted in the DPA; if your team requires different caps we can escalate to commercial.
- Data deletion & retention: the DPA includes clauses that map to the 90-day default for POC logs; we can add a production SLA for retention/archival when you move to Dedicated.

Please send any redlines directly to legal@redwood.com and copy me; we'll put a high priority on this deal given the POC timeline.

Regards,
Monica Patel
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference

Emily / Daniel —

Appreciate the quick turn. Summary of next steps so we have alignment: 
- You confirm DPA redline by June 25 (email to legal@redwood.com).
- Aditya will share SOC auditor contact + CAIQ updates in Drive (done).
- POC kickoff: June 22 — tech onboarding call (30 min) at 10:00 AM PT. Please confirm availability.
- Target security signoff: July 8, procurement close by July 12.

I booked a tentative 30-minute slot on June 22 and included a DocuSign link we'll use for signatures once terms are agreed: https://www.docusign.net/Finalize/NXV-POC-47
